newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares mixed, banks attract interest.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares mixed, banks attract interest.

text.p: Bank shares maintained their dominance of the bourse by the close of trade on Wednesday as market indices closed mixed.
The official list edged up 0.35 points to 944.27 points while the broader group A slid 25.19 points to 1832.43 points.
"There was nothing especially interesting," said one broker. "It's (trade) still dominated by banks."
Vilniaus Bank maintained its advance, marching up to 245 litas from 243.20 litas in 271,000 litas central market trade.
"The six-month results were really good," said one broker.
Vilniaus Bank said on Monday its profit for the first six months of 1997 was 21.4 million litas.
"I don't think the price is high. It has the potential to go up but just in the longer term, maybe one month," he added.
Vilniaus Bank shares also saw 1.96 million litas turnover in block trades at 245 litas.
Hermis Bank held steady at 210 litas amid a healthy 518,000 litas turnover on the central market.
"It stayed at 210 because there's still good supply, but I'm optimistic about Hermis," said one broker. "It will increase in the near future, only maybe next week."
Hermis saw 2.95 million litas turnover in block trades at prices between 170.20 litas to 210 litas. Hermis said last week its half-year profit was 14.3 million litas.
Group A anchor Lithuanian Gas brought down the rest of its index, falling to 1.56 litas from 1.69 litas, although turnover was a modest 7,000 litas.
Brokers say Lithuanian Gas shares have long-term potential but their short-term prospects remain uncertain.
